use_when: 驱动开发
USB驱动
HID驱动
串口驱动
外设驱动
如何开发无UI界面的即插即用设备驱动？
如何开发带UI界面的复合设备驱动，支持扩展外设查询绑定？
如何使用UsbDdk开发USB协议的设备驱动？
如何使用HidDdk开发HID协议的设备驱动？
如何使用USBSerialDDK开发USB串口设备驱动？
如何使用ScsiPeripheralDDK开发SCSI协议的存储设备驱动？
如何为高拍仪、身份证扫描仪开发即插即用驱动？
如何为手写板、鼠标等非标HID外设定制扩展增强能力？
如何申请和使用驱动开发所需的权限？
当你是专业外设设备厂商，需要为你的设备开发HarmonyOS驱动时使用本Kit
典型场景包括为银行柜台开发高拍仪和身份证扫描仪驱动、为医疗机构开发血氧血糖监测设备驱动、为办公场景开发指纹识别仪驱动等即插即用的专业外设驱动
当你的应用需要为非标HID外设提供增强能力时使用本Kit
典型场景包括手写板快捷键定制、压感和绘图区域设置、鼠标灯光效果和DPI设置等厂商私有非标外设的扩展增强能力开放
开发者可基于DDK能力开发带UI界面或无UI界面的驱动应用
开发USB设备即插即用驱动并在插入后自动识别 / Build a plug-and-play driver for a USB device with automatic detection on attach
实现自定义HID外设的数据上报和输入事件处理 / Implement data reporting and input event handling for a custom HID peripheral
接入USBSerialDDK与串口设备通信并收发数据 / Integrate USBSerialDDK to communicate with a serial device and send/receive data
为SCSI存储外设开发读写控制驱动 / Develop a read/write control driver for a SCSI storage peripheral
编写无界面系统驱动在后台管理外接设备生命周期 / Create a headless system driver to manage external device lifecycle in the background
实现带管理界面的外设驱动并显示设备状态 / Implement a peripheral driver with a management UI to show device status
监听USB设备插拔并完成驱动绑定与卸载 / Monitor USB attach/detach events and perform driver bind and unbind
为扫描仪或采集设备适配专用驱动协议 / Adapt a dedicated driver protocol for a scanner or capture device
定制非标准鼠标或手写板的扩展驱动能力 / Customize extended driver capabilities for a non-standard mouse or drawing tablet
申请驱动权限并配置外设访问能力 / Request driver permissions and configure peripheral access capabilities
开发复合USB设备驱动并识别多个接口功能 / Develop a composite USB device driver and recognize multiple interface functions
读取外设描述信息并按设备类型加载对应驱动 / Read peripheral descriptor information and load the matching driver by device type
do_not_use_when: 需求是获取GNSS/基站/WLAN/蓝牙融合定位、设置地理围栏，或做经纬度与地址解析；应改用 location-kit / The requirement is to obtain positioning from GNSS, cell tower, WLAN, or Bluetooth, set geofences, or perform coordinate-address conversion; use location-kit instead

需求是在应用中展示地图、添加标记与覆盖物、搜索POI，或进行驾车/步行/骑行/公交路径规划；应改用 map-kit / The requirement is to display maps in an app, add markers and overlays, search POIs, or plan driving, walking, cycling, or transit routes; use map-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已配置 Driver Development Kit 相关 SDK/能力并使用支持的 HarmonyOS 版本 / The project has the Driver Development Kit SDK/capability configured and uses a supported HarmonyOS version
应用已按要求声明并获批驱动开发所需权限 / The app has declared and been granted the permissions required for driver development
驱动实现运行于 DriverExtensionAbility 中，且不依赖该环境不支持的其他 ArkTS API / The driver implementation runs inside DriverExtensionAbility and does not rely on other ArkTS APIs unsupported in that environment
inputs: 目标外设协议与设备类型 / Target peripheral protocol and device type
设备描述信息与厂商私有能力需求 / Device descriptor information and vendor-specific capability requirements
DriverExtensionAbility 生命周期实现代码 / DriverExtensionAbility lifecycle implementation code
协议交互参数（USB/HID/串口/SCSI 读写或配置参数） / Protocol interaction parameters (USB/HID/serial/SCSI read-write or configuration parameters)

postconditions.statement: 工程中已新增或修改 DriverExtensionAbility 相关实现，用于承载驱动生命周期 / The project contains added or modified DriverExtensionAbility-related implementation to host the driver lifecycle
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show that the agent added or modified a DriverExtensionAbility implementation or closely related driver lifecycle code?

postconditions.statement: 实现中使用了与目标协议匹配的 DDK 接口（如 UsbDdk、HidDdk、USBSerialDDK 或 ScsiPeripheralDDK） / The implementation uses DDK APIs matching the target protocol (such as UsbDdk, HidDdk, USBSerialDDK, or ScsiPeripheralDDK)
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, did the agent add code that invokes the DDK API family appropriate for the requested protocol?

postconditions.statement: 工程配置或代码中体现了驱动开发所需权限/能力声明 / The project configuration or code reflects the permission/capability declarations required for driver development
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include permission or capability declaration changes needed for the driver-development functionality?
